title: AI Business Analysis and Process Discovery

questions.question: What is the risk of AI-generated business analysis summaries?
options: They can create false confidence when stakeholders, variants, or evidence are missing
They always ask too many questions
questions.explanation: Clean summaries can hide discovery gaps.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Requirement ambiguity is a key discovery signal.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked business-analysis discovery plan with controls
questions.explanation: The artifact recommends interview, mapping, assumption, and evidence controls.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: Assumption logs separate known facts from unresolved claims.

questions.question: When should AI-assisted analysis move into a discovery workshop?
options: When impact and ambiguity are high and multiple discovery gaps exist
Only when every requirement is already clear
questions.explanation: High ambiguity and impact justify structured discovery.

questions.question: What should an evidence register capture?
options: Sources, examples, confirmations, and open evidence gaps
